title: General Linear Weil Representation Decomposition
body_html:
General Linear Weil Representation Decomposition

Let \(V\) be an \(n\)-dimensional vector space over the finite field \(k\) with \(q\) elements, and let \(W^V\) be Gérardin's general linear Weil representation of \(G(V)\simeq \operatorname{GL}(V)\).

The tensor product \(W^V\otimes W^V\) is the natural representation of \(G(V)\) on the space of complex functions on \(V\times V^\vee\).

For each character \(\theta\) of \(k^\times\), let \(W^V(\theta)\) denote the \(\theta\)-isotypic part for the center \(k^\times\subseteq G(V)\). If \(\theta\ne 1\), then \(W^V(\theta)\) is simple of degree \[ \frac{q^n-1}{q-1}. \]

If \(n>1\), the trivial central character part decomposes as \[ W^V(1)=2\cdot \mathbf{1}\oplus W^V(1)', \] where \(W^V(1)'\) is simple of degree \[ \frac{q^n-1}{q-1}-1. \]

All simple components of \(W^V\) have Borel type in the sense of parabolic type.
